attributes.text: Set up takes a few minutes.
Tap every one that applies. You can change this later. None is also allowed.
Arthritis Stiff joints, especially in the morning.
Diabetes Blood sugar, meals, feet, and tablets that go with food.
PCOD Cysts on the ovaries. Not the same chart as PCOS.
PCOS Cycles, and often insulin, skin, or hair riding together.
After a heart attack Medicines stay. Walking stays gentle. Chest pain is never 'later'.
